text:
The patient has irritable bowel syntax, which involves the colon. Its sympathetic preganglionic neurons sit in the intermediolateral cell column of the spinal cord at about T10-L2. The team note says T7-L2, but I'm keeping T10-L2 because the colon's supply runs through the lesser and least thoracic splanchnic nerves (T10-T11 and T12) and the lumbar splanchnic nerves (L1-L2).

CONFIDENCE: 72
